en.seeHowIGotHere: The journey from robotics to engineering leadership
en.s1_subtitle_line1: Before software existed in isolation, I engineered physical systems.
en.s1_subtitle_line2: Motor torque control, closed-loop controllers, and embedded hardware.
en.s1_detail: B.Sc. Mechatronics Engineering · Control Systems & Physical Controllers
en.s2_subtitle_line1: Kinematics, inverse dynamics, and real-time control loops.
en.s2_subtitle_line2: Rigorous algorithmic motion planning published internationally.
en.s3_subtitle_line1: A machine without code is silent steel.
en.s3_subtitle_line2: Software is the breath and spirit that turns cold mechanisms
en.s3_subtitle_line3: into autonomous intelligence and purposeful execution.
en.s4_subtitle_line1: Moving to Italy to master Management Engineering (Ingegneria Gestionale).
en.s4_subtitle_line2: Operations research, international supply chains, and project governance.
en.s5_subtitle_line1: Early on, offers were scarce and doors didn't open automatically.
en.s5_subtitle_line2: I didn't wait for permission. I built relentlessly, let execution speak, and turned resistance into momentum.
en.s7_subtitle: Senior engineers don't just solve problems; they orchestrate teams and deliver commitments on schedule.
en.s8_title:
The Bridge: European Innovation
to High-Growth Markets
en.s8_subtitle_line1: Connecting Europe's aesthetic & medical manufacturers with Iran's thriving market.
en.s8_subtitle_line2: Evaluating devices with engineering rigor; structuring distribution with commercial discipline.
en.s9_body_line1: Senior Consultant at Capgemini & International Business Development Representative.
en.s9_body_line2: Bridging precision technology with strategic market expansion. Let's build the next venture.
en.story_hero_subtitle: Where physical mechatronics, Italian management engineering, and enterprise consulting meet international market expansion.
